experiences.name: Bangkok Night Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore Bangkok's legendary street food scene after dark when temperatures drop and the city comes alive. Sample pad thai, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, and fresh spring rolls from iconic vendors at Yaowarat Road (Chinatown). Evening tours avoid the intense daytime heat and offer the most vibrant atmosphere with locals and travelers alike.

experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Sunset Boat Tour
experiences.description: Join a late afternoon island-hopping boat tour around the stunning Phi Phi archipelago. Depart around 3pm to avoid peak sun and heat, snorkel in sheltered bays, visit Maya Bay, and enjoy the dramatic limestone cliffs bathed in golden sunset light. The cooler late-day hours make this far more comfortable than midday excursions.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Night Market Food Crawl
experiences.description: Wander through Koh Lanta's atmospheric night market sampling southern Thai specialties including massaman curry, fresh grilled seafood, and coconut-based desserts. The market runs entirely in the evening, making it a perfect heat-avoiding cultural and culinary experience that showcases authentic local island life away from tourist crowds.
experiences.location: Koh Lanta Old Town, Krabi Province

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Cooking Class (Indoor)
experiences.description: Take an immersive indoor Thai cooking class in Chiang Mai, learning to prepare 4-5 classic dishes including green curry, tom kha soup, and pad see ew. Classes are held in air-conditioned kitchen studios, making this an ideal activity during hot or rainy weather. You gain hands-on cultural knowledge and a skill to take home.

experiences.name: Railay Beach Evening Kayaking & Bioluminescence
experiences.description: Paddle through the iconic sea caves and hidden lagoons around Railay Beach at dusk and into the early evening. The cooler temperatures make kayaking comfortable, and after dark you may witness stunning bioluminescent plankton glowing in the water. Accessible only by boat, Railay's dramatic karst scenery is best appreciated in the softer evening light.
